root: Each EKS attempt writes to ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI/attempt-NN/.

layout.snapshots/<path_sha256>/<content_sha256>: Immutable payload snapshots. path_sha256 is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 relative path; content_sha256 is SHA-256 of exact bytes.
layout.index/s3-file-index-<sha256>.json: Content-addressed final index. It maps each final local relative path and byte count to its exact SHA-256 and immutable S3 snapshot key.
layout.upload-history.jsonl: Append-only local record of each successfully uploaded payload snapshot. Each line contains upload time, relative path, byte count, SHA-256 and S3 key. Its final bytes are also uploaded as a snapshot and listed in the index.

local_files.data/index.json: Top-level factor-base index; binds coordinate-bit candidate, all curve families, complete status, and same-base-for-m reuse.
local_files.data/<family>/manifest.json: Per-family curve identity, selector map, shard list, counts and content hashes.
local_files.data/<family>/part-NNNN.bin.zst: Compressed shard payload. N83FB02 header is 32 bytes; each record is selector_index:u32-le followed by y:u128-le.
local_files.data/<family>/part-NNNN.json: Shard metadata with range, family, coordinate bit, candidate identifier, counts and payload SHA-256.
local_files.run-manifest.json: Attempt identity, start/end, exit status, instrument/protocol hashes and non-performance boundary.
local_files.manifest.sha256: SHA-256 checks for final run files except itself, upload-history.jsonl, and s3-file-index.json. The S3 index covers those excluded files.
local_files.protocol.json: Exact frozen protocol bytes copied into the attempt.
local_files.runner.sh: Exact runner bytes used by the attempt.
local_files.instrument: Exact native factor_base executable used by the attempt.
local_files.producer.log: Producer stdout/stderr; incomplete and failed attempts retain it.

preservation.overwrite_policy: No sync or mutable stable object key. Every payload version is written to a content-addressed S3 key.
preservation.partial_attempts: Periodic snapshots remain in the attempt prefix if the process is interrupted. The final index is written only after graceful termination.
preservation.validation: Recompute each object SHA-256 and byte count; verify manifest.sha256; then check data/index.json and per-family manifests before accepting enumeration.
